plan: Drive: from Blue River, about 93 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Cedar St, Hwy 5, Lloyd Rd, E Old North Thompson Hwy.
Park: 51.97939, -120.32992, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the unnamed road stretch, 3.5 km one way. About 70 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-15, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
